decision: Adopt paper_goal.json and evidence_ledger.json as the canonical paper objective and evidence boundary for all future Human Slot work.
rationale: The project has historical metrics, engineering pilots, and one passed representation gate, but no generative model or transfer claim. A canonical evidence ledger prevents diagnostic activity from being promoted into paper conclusions.
reopen_condition: Any change to the paper goal, Stage-1 decoder contract, or evidence eligibility requires a new explicit decision event.
